messages.subject: Today @1PM in Wickson 2120J: Robert Hijmans on spatial analysis
parts:
Hi all,

A quick reminder that today's D-RUG meeting is in 2120J Wickson instead of our normal room, 1-3PM.  Robert Hijmans will be presenting on spatial analysis in R.

Noam

On Mon, May 20, 2013 at 4:03 PM, Noam Ross <noam...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi all,

This week at D-RUG we'll have a talk from Robert Hijmans. Robert is the author of the raster package - the essential way to deal with gridded spatial data in R, as well as the dismo (species distribution modeling) and geosphere (spherical trigonometry) packages. He also teaches GEO200CN - Quantitative geography, not to mention his great research on species distribution modeling .Robert will give a talk about tools for spatial analysis in R. Come with your spatial/geographic analysis questions!

Note that this week's D-RUG will be in 2120J Wickson - this is the room just to the right of our regular meeting space. It will at the usual time: 1-3 PM, with the usual snacks.

See you there!

Noam
